exits.discharge_rule: Discharge each acquired foreign resource exactly once before returning ownership to the caller.
exits.future_evidence: An admitted emitter family must execute a native witness that checks every acquired resource is discharged on normal return.

exits.discharge_rule: Discharge each acquired foreign resource exactly once before propagating the modeled error result.
exits.future_evidence: An admitted emitter family must execute a native witness that checks cleanup and the observed error result together.
